# Agent HUD

A local dashboard for coding agent skills, instruction files and Claude Code
plugins. Free, macOS only for now, MIT license, no account.

## What it does

Coding agents load available skills' names and descriptions into the model's
context at the start of a session. Descriptions of unused skills waste input tokens.
Agent HUD shows how many skills a selected project loads, and lets you save the plugins and
skills you use together as a group and apply a different group per project.
It also shows which instruction files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md and others) a
project has and how they are linked to each other, and can set a skill to
manual-only per project. The switches update Claude Code settings only. Skill
linking and group changes also add or remove project skill links used by other
agents. Worktree sharing adds missing skill links to selected checkouts of the
same repository without copying plugin settings, hooks or MCP configuration.
Saved defaults can apply to new worktrees every 15 seconds while HUD runs; use
`agent-hud worktrees apply` before launching an agent to apply them first.
It reads and writes settings files on the machine it runs on and needs no
account. On its own it makes one request, a GitHub Releases check once a
day for update notices; a Homebrew install can also update itself when the
user clicks Update now, and then Homebrew does the download.

## Links

- Homepage (English): https://ganggangstone.github.io/agent-hud/
- Homepage (Korean): https://ganggangstone.github.io/agent-hud/ko/
- Repository: https://github.com/ganggangstone/agent-hud
- Install with an AI agent: ask it to "Install Agent HUD from https://github.com/ganggangstone/agent-hud and follow the For AI agents section of its README"
- Install: `brew install --cask ganggangstone/tap/agent-hud-app` (app icon plus the `agent-hud` command), or `brew install ganggangstone/tap/agent-hud && brew services start agent-hud` for the command only (or `git clone https://github.com/ganggangstone/agent-hud.git && cd agent-hud && ./install.sh`)
- Design decisions: https://github.com/ganggangstone/agent-hud/blob/main/docs/ADR.md

## Summary

- Price: free
- Platform: macOS (Linux via running `server.py` directly; Windows not supported yet)
- License: MIT
- Dependencies: none for the dashboard — a single Python file, standard library only. Optional token counts install tiktoken into the tool's own folder (`agent-hud tokens setup`)
- Account: not required
- Network use: one GitHub Releases check a day; Homebrew downloads an update only when the user clicks Update now; the optional token-count setup downloads tiktoken and one public vocabulary file once
